rationale: The side-door sensor (SEN-D1) is offline with a battery level of 6%, while its RSSI is healthy at -62 dBm and it remains correctly bound in both the base station and app. The log confirms "door_side battery level 6%", and the KB notes low battery causes sensors to go offline and miss events. The repainting/misalignment theory is not supported by the data; the root cause is a depleted battery.

repair_steps: Instruct the customer to replace the battery in the side-door sensor (SEN-D1) with a fresh CR123A battery.
After replacement, ask the customer to open and close the side door to verify the sensor triggers an event and the app shows it online.
Confirm in the app that the side-door sensor status changes to online and no further offline alerts occur.
output.customer_reply: We found the side-door sensor's battery is critically low at 6%, causing it to go offline and miss events. The signal strength and binding are fine, so no realignment is needed. Please replace the battery with a fresh CR123A, then test by opening the door. The sensor should come back online and alerts will stop. Let us know if you need further help.

results.text: Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.

CAM-S1 runs on a rechargeable battery lasting 3 to 6 months. Below 10 percent the camera disables live view and may miss events; below 3 percent it goes offline. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Frequent motion events in busy areas shorten battery life; enable power-saving mode.

Uplink loss of the base station, pairing timeouts, capacity limit reached, weak signal of a single device, low battery, outdated peripheral firmware that upgrades successfully via OTA, and full storage. Provide the customer with step-by-step instructions and confirm the issue is resolved.

complaint: The side-door sensor shows offline and the app sends me an alert every few hours. I opened the door to test it and nothing happened. We had the house repainted last week and the painter may have bumped the sensor, so I think it is misaligned. I haven't touched it since.
